listing.name: Halo 2 — Open Halo 2 (andrewnakas)
listing.summary: The README describes launch and online-room/OpenLive procedures. Console 640×480 output and DSP reverb are absent, and no complete campaign is claimed. Mac, Linux and browser versions are planned only. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own original retail Xbox disc as Redump ISO, XISO or extracted default.xbe. The launcher checks one supported retail revision. This guide does not include its exact accepted fingerprint; check the project’s release manifest before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run OpenHalo2.exe to import your own disc and generate and compile halo2_recomp.exe locally. LLVM and the code-generation tool are bundled. Supply Microsoft CRT/SDK libraries from an existing Visual Studio installation or the documented licensed xwin download. OpenGL3.3 is required.

warnings: The README describes launch and online-room/OpenLive procedures. Console 640×480 output and DSP reverb are absent, and no complete campaign is claimed. Mac, Linux and browser versions are planned only.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
